title: The Tampered Scrubbers
logline: When life support filters in the lower docks begin failing, an environmental mechanic hires a pilot to trace who is siphoning fresh charcoal cartridges.

roles.description: A night-shift life support technician whose lungs rattle from inhaling unscrubbed carbon dioxide.
Oversees cargo allocation with an iron ledger; sells refurbished air parts to illegal mining rigs.
The subterranean atmospheric filtration plant beneath the station's heavy industrial docks.
An unmonitored docking slip where scrapped atmospheric hardware is packed into generic shipping crates.

public_situation: Dockworkers on {system}'s industrial tier report chronic headaches and stale air as atmospheric scrubbers fail daily inspection.
private_truth: The dockmaster has been swapping fresh scrubber cartridges with spent units and fencing the medical-grade activated carbon to off-grid asteroid smelters.

beats.public_change: Station safety officers issue an advisory urging lower deck residents to limit strenuous work due to carbon spikes.

missions.reason: The technician needs an outsider to collect a set of spent filter cores directly from the maintenance airlock before the daytime shift wipes the logs.
missions.private_fact: The technician tampered with the core seals last night to leave unique dye markers on whoever handled the stolen filters.

beats.public_change: Alarms sound across the berths as the secondary scrubber manifold overheats from blocked porous mesh.

missions.reason: The mechanic asks the pilot to scan cargo pallets docked at the scrap berth to verify if the tagged filter cores are being crated for export.
missions.private_fact: The dockmaster is logged as the registered owner of the export barge and receives payment directly to a personal blind escrow.

beats.public_change: The dockmaster locks down the freight lifts to trap the mechanic before station inspectors arrive.

missions.reason: The technician asks the pilot to courier an emergency diagnostic bypass module straight to the vault to keep the breathable air flowing.
missions.private_fact: The bypass module will overload the backup turbine within forty-eight hours unless permanent fresh filters are installed.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot delivers the bypass to the vault while holding proof of the dockmaster's theft. The dockmaster offers a lucrative freight kickback to suppress the logs, while the choking mechanic begs for justice.

options.label: Hand the scan logs to the station magistrates to arrest the dockmaster
Accept the dockmaster's hush money and let the refurbished filters ship
Blackmail the dockmaster into returning all stolen filters without involving magistrates

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes the theft logs to the station magistrates.
resolutions.summary: {role:corrupt_dockmaster} is stripped of office and imprisoned, while {role:mechanic_whistleblower} receives a promotion to chief life support engineer.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot uncovered who was stealing the breathing filters from the lower dock scrubbers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the dockmaster's bribe.
resolutions.summary: {role:corrupt_dockmaster} continues siphoning life support parts, while {role:mechanic_whistleblower} is fired on trumped-up safety charges.

consequences.public_summary: Rumors claim a pilot took a payout to look the other way while dock air went bad.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot blackmails the dockmaster into restoring the filters.
resolutions.summary: {role:corrupt_dockmaster} quietly returns the filters to avoid arrest, while {role:mechanic_whistleblower} monitors the air in uneasy silence.

resolutions.reached_by: The bypass fails or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: The lower docks choke on toxic exhaust; {role:corrupt_dockmaster} blames equipment age and {role:mechanic_whistleblower} flees the system.

loose_threads.detail: Refurbished filter drums bear serial stamps matching an off-system supply order cancelled six months ago.
An offshore account held in a scrap broker's name received regular monthly transfers from the dockmaster's payroll.

radio_hooks: Lower dock workers in {system} stage walkout over deteriorating atmospheric quality.
Station engineering denies atmospheric shortages, citing seasonal ventilation lag.
Black market prices for pressurized oxygen cannisters double across {system} outposts.

voice_direction.mechanic_whistleblower: Raspy, persistent, speaking in fast short bursts with grim, humourless urgency.
voice_direction.corrupt_dockmaster: Smooth, condescending, speaking in comfortable administrative clichés to minimise serious emergencies.
